item.title: Trump says no rush to decide on new Iran strikes, looks to next year
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Thursday appeared to push a decision on renewed major strikes against Iran into next year, extending a timeline that he had previously suggested could come to a head after this month’s US midterm elections. item.title: World-famous hippo Fiona dies in US days after swallowing visitor’s hat
item.description: World-famous hippopotamus Fiona has died after several failed attempts by vets to remove a woolly hat that she accidentally swallowed, the Cincinnati Zoo announced Thursday.
